# Option dictionary

<!-- generated by tools/gen_reference.py from the code; do not edit by hand -->

Every option of the package, generated from the code (`python tools/gen_reference.py`): the keys a problem
profile may contain, the command-line flags of `qss-run` (= `python -m phrport.phr`), `qss-coils` and
`qss-check`, and the environment variables. A test fails when an option is added without documentation.

How to read the "Set with" column:

* `profile: phr.aspect_target` is the key `"aspect_target"` in the `"phr"` section of the profile JSON
  (`profile: equilibrium.qi_options.nalpha` is nested in the `"qi_options"` dictionary);
* `--flag` is a command-line flag of `qss-run`; every such flag can also go into the profile's `"run"` section
  as `"flag_name": value` (dashes become underscores, see [profile.md](profile.md));
* an option with both is read from the profile and can be overridden on the command line;
* `(not settable)` options are fixed in the code (listed for completeness).

Defaults are the built-in ones (no profile: PHR's nfp2 QA problem). "Applies to": `all`, `QS`, `QI` (with
`equilibrium.physics: "qi"`) or `finite beta` (with `phr.finite_beta: true`). The meaning, math and paper values
of every constraint are in [constraints.md](constraints.md).

## Problem and physics (what is optimized)

| option | set with | default | units | applies to | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `helicity_m` | profile: equilibrium.helicity_m | `1` | - | QS | QS helicity M (1 for QA and QH). |
| `helicity_n` | profile: equilibrium.helicity_n | `0` | - | QS | QS helicity N (0 for QA, nfp for QH; sign as in simsopt). |
| `input_file` | profile: equilibrium.input_file | `''` | - | all | VMEC input deck (INDATA namelist): the seed boundary, nfp, pressure / current profiles, PHIEDGE. Absolute, relative to the profile's folder or to the repository, or __ROOT__/... Default: inputs/input.nfp2_QA. |
| `nfp` | profile: equilibrium.nfp | `2` | - | all | Number of field periods (must match the deck). |
| `physics` | profile: equilibrium.physics | `'qs'` | - | all | Objective: "qs" = quasi-symmetry residual (VMEX QuasisymmetryRatioResidual), "qi" = smooth constructed quasi-isodynamic residual (Goodman et al. 2023). |
| `qi_options` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options | `{}` | - | QI | QI residual, mirror, max-J and well-shaping options (the "qi.*" entries). |
| `qi_surfaces` | profile: equilibrium.qi_surfaces | `(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9)` | - | QI | Normalized-flux surfaces of the constructed-QI residual (default 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9). |
| `qs_surfaces` | profile: equilibrium.qs_surfaces | `None` | - | QS | Normalized-flux surfaces of the QS residual (default 0, 0.1, ..., 1). |
| `seed_ellipse` | profile: equilibrium.seed_ellipse | `0.07` | - | all | If the deck is exactly axisymmetric, add this (2,1) rotating ellipse to it (PHR's start: 0.07); 0 keeps the deck unchanged (docs/seeding.md). |
| `alpha_weight_floor` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.alpha_weight_floor | `0.0001` | - | QI | Floor of the field-line weights. |
| `alpha_weights` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.alpha_weights | `False` | - | QI | Weight field lines by their bounce structure. |
| `bmin_soft` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.bmin_soft | `0.002` | - | QI | Soft min along a line of the flatness rows. |
| `bmin_surfaces` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.bmin_surfaces | `()` | - | QI | Extra surfaces of the well-bottom flatness rows. |
| `bmin_weight` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.bmin_weight | `0` | - | QI | > 0: well-bottom flatness rows (B_min alpha-variance) appended to the QI residual with this weight. |
| `phimin` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.phimin | `0` | - | QI | Toroidal origin of the field-line grid. |
| `soft` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.soft | `0.0002` | - | QI | Smoothing temperature of the constructed-QI residual (relative to <B>). |
| `weights` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.weights | `None` | - | QI | Per-surface weights of the QI residual. |
| `R0` | --R0 (qss-seed) | `1` | m | all | qss-seed tokamak / rotating-ellipse: major radius. |
| `amp` | --amp (qss-seed) | `0.05` | - | all | qss-seed rotating-ellipse: (1,1) ellipse amplitude relative to the minor radius. |
| `aspect` | --aspect (qss-seed) | `6` | - | all | qss-seed tokamak / rotating-ellipse: aspect ratio (area-equivalent for kappa != 1). |
| `axis_shift` | --axis-shift (qss-seed) | `0` | m | all | qss-seed rotating-ellipse: (0,1) helical axis shift. |
| `brk` | --break (qss-seed) | `qa` | - | all | qss-seed tokamak --break: symmetry break qa (1e-3 on (1,1), (2,1)), qi (re-signed rotating ellipse + helical axis shift, 2e-3) or none. |
| `delta` | --delta (qss-seed) | `0` | - | all | qss-seed tokamak: triangularity. |
| `kappa` | --kappa (qss-seed) | `1` | - | all | qss-seed tokamak: elongation. |
| `nfp` | --nfp (qss-seed) | `None` | - | all | qss-seed: field periods of the new deck (default: the template's or the wout's). |
| `perturb` | --perturb (qss-seed) | `[]` | - | all | qss-seed tokamak: extra boundary terms m,n,rc,zs (repeatable). |
| `phiedge` | --phiedge (qss-seed) | `None` | Wb | all | qss-seed: toroidal flux at the edge (default: the template's). |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `mirror_tau` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.mirror_tau | `None` | - | QI | Soft-max temperature of mirror_all (alias of mirror_all_tau; paper 0.002). |

## Coil-fit flux bound (the coil row of the outer problem)

| option | set with | default | units | applies to | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `carry_flux_from_mode` | --carry-flux-from-mode | `0` | - | all | Carry only into modes >= this. |
| `carry_flux_multiplier` | --carry-flux-multiplier | `False` | - | all | Keep the coil row's multiplier and penalty across modes (target still re-captured). |
| `cs_threshold` | profile: phr.cs_threshold | `0.15` | m | all | Phantom-flux guard: below 0.5 x this coil-surface distance (or c0 <= 1e-7) the honest mean (B.n//B/)^2 replaces c0 and the flux gradient is dropped. |
| `enable_coils` | --no-coils | `True` | - | all | Coils in the loop (flag --no-coils turns them off: equilibrium only, two-stage first stage). |
| `final_mode_flux_target` | --final-mode-flux-target | `0` | - | all | Absolute c0 target in the final mode (0 = off). |
| `flux_metric_scale` | --flux-metric-scale | `1` | - | all | Scale S of the coil row S c0 (paper 500). |
| `flux_phr_target` | --flux-phr-target | `0` | - | all | Absolute c0 target when flux_target_frac <= 0. |
| `flux_target_bn` | profile: phr.flux_target_bn, --flux-target-bn | `0` | - | all | Bound on </B.n/>/</B/>: captured target c0 (b*/b)^2, never above the frac target (0 = off). |
| `flux_target_floor` | --flux-target-floor | `0` | - | all | Captured target = max(frac c0, floor) (stops frac^k compounding). |
| `flux_target_frac` | --flux-target-frac | `0.5` | - | all | Adaptive bound: at the start of each mode the target is frac x the achieved c0 (paper 0.5; <= 0 = use flux_phr_target). |

## Finite beta (plasma field in the coil problem)

| option | set with | default | units | applies to | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `step` | --step (qss-coils) | `None` | - | all | Continuation step of the equilibrium used for the plasma field. |
| `fb_current_from_G` | profile: phr.fb_current_from_G | `False` | - | finite beta | Scale the coil currents to the current the equilibrium links (lambda_G = pi /G_edge/ / (mu0 nfp I)). |
| `fb_digits_grad` | profile: phr.fb_digits_grad | `4` | - | finite beta | Virtual-casing accuracy (digits) of the field term. |
| `fb_digits_value` | profile: phr.fb_digits_value | `6` | - | finite beta | Virtual-casing accuracy (digits) of the plasma field values. |
| `fb_field_sign` | profile: phr.fb_field_sign | `1.0` | - | finite beta | Orientation of the plasma field relative to the coils (+1 / -1; LP QA beta: -1). |
| `fb_n` | profile: phr.fb_n | `32` | - | finite beta | Virtual-casing grid n x n per field period. |
| `finite_beta` | profile: phr.finite_beta | `False` | - | finite beta | Plasma field (virtual casing on the VMEX state) in the coil residual, with its envelope-gradient term (needs --eq-jacobian exact for the field term). |
| `pressure` | --pressure (qss-seed) | `None` | Pa | finite beta | qss-seed: generic finite-beta deck, p(s) = P0 (1 - s), current-free. |

## Continuation and optimizer

| option | set with | default | units | applies to | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PHRPORT_TRUST_FLOOR` | environment PHRPORT_TRUST_FLOOR | `""` | - | all | Floor on a carried trust radius (production preset 1e-3). |
| `PHRPORT_TRUST_RESET_STEP` | environment PHRPORT_TRUST_RESET_STEP | `""` | - | all | 1: reset the carried trust radius at a new continuation step (production preset). |
| `ntor_extra` | profile: equilibrium.ntor_extra | `0` | - | all | Continuation step k frees /n/ <= k + ntor_extra (capped at surf_ntor) instead of /n/ <= k: lets the axis torsion / bean rotation in early (tokamak cold starts). |
| `al_outer_iter` | --al-outer-iter | `6` | - | all | Augmented-Lagrangian outers per step (multiplier / penalty updates). |
| `carry_trust_radius` | --no-carry-trust-radius | `False` | - | all | Start each inner solve with the previous largest accepted step (paper preset; --no-carry-trust-radius undoes it, as in the QI tokamak start). |
| `coil_fail_policy` | --coil-fail-policy | `use` | - | all | Coil result not ok but finite: use it (PHR) or sentinel (reject). |
| `coil_nonfinite_policy` | --coil-nonfinite-policy | `sentinel` | - | all | Non-finite coil result: sentinel (reject trial) or phr_nan. |
| `eq_jacobian` | --eq-jacobian | `fd` | - | all | Equilibrium Jacobian block: fd (PHR forward differences) or exact (implicit VMEX tangents; paper). |
| `exact_jac_gauge` | --exact-jac-gauge | `sqrt` | - | all | Gauge of the exact Jacobian map: sqrt (default) or frozen. |
| `final_mode_kkt_exit` | --final-mode-kkt-exit | `False` | - | all | Final mode exits only when KKT feasibility and stationarity pass. |
| `full_outer_budget` | --no-full-outer-budget | `False` | - | all | Run every outer of every mode even when all rows are feasible (paper). |
| `kkt_extra_outers` | --kkt-extra-outers | `3` | - | all | Extra outers allowed by the final-mode KKT exit. |
| `kkt_stationarity_tol` | --kkt-stationarity-tol | `0.1` | - | all | Stationarity tolerance of the final-mode KKT exit. |
| `max_nfev` | --max-nfev | `20` | - | all | Function evaluations per inner least-squares solve (paper 30). |
| `n_continuation_steps` | --n-continuation-steps | `4` | - | all | Continuation steps: step k frees boundary modes /m/, /n/ <= k. |
| `rho_init` | --rho-init | `1` | - | all | Initial PHR penalty of every row. |
| `rho_max` | --rho-max | `10000` | - | all | Penalty cap. |
| `rho_tau` | --rho-tau | `2` | - | all | Penalty growth factor when a violation does not decrease enough. |
| `rho_theta` | --rho-theta | `0.25` | - | all | Required violation decrease ratio before the penalty grows. |
| `skip_surface_opt` | --skip-surface-opt | `False` | - | all | Skip the boundary optimization (coils / metrics only). |
| `surface_dof_reset_threshold` | --surface-dof-reset-threshold | `1e-05` | - | all | Warm coil start if the boundary moved by <= this, else cold. |

| `dist_grid` | profile: coils.dist_grid | `(128, 64)` | - | all | Coil-surface soft-min grid on the full torus. |

| `ns_array` | profile: equilibrium.ns_array | `(16, 50)` | - | all | VMEC radial ladder: surfaces per stage (PHR 16, 50; paper 16/50 or 25/50). |
| `surf_mpol` | profile: equilibrium.surf_mpol | `5` | - | all | Boundary Fourier table: poloidal modes m <= surf_mpol are DOFs (as continuation reaches them). |

| `vmec_mpol` | profile: equilibrium.vmec_mpol | `None` | - | all | Fixed VMEC resolution mpol = ntor at every step (default: 3 + continuation step, PHR). |
| `vmec_ntor` | profile: equilibrium.vmec_ntor | `None` | - | all | Fixed VMEC ntor different from vmec_mpol (e.g. to resolve ripple modes). |
| `jreal_nalpha` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.jreal_nalpha | `24` | - | QI | Field lines of the J integrals. |
| `jreal_nphi` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.jreal_nphi | `401` | - | QI | Points per field line of the J integrals. |
| `mboz` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.mboz | `16` | - | QI | Boozer poloidal resolution of the traceable Boozer transform. |
| `n_bounce` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.n_bounce | `31` | - | QI | Bounce levels of the constructed-QI target. |
| `nalpha` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.nalpha | `21` | - | QI | Field lines per surface of the QI residual. |
| `nboz` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.nboz | `16` | - | QI | Boozer toroidal resolution. |
| `nphi` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.nphi | `101` | - | QI | Points per field line (one field period) of the QI residual. |
| `oversample` | profile: equilibrium.qi_options.oversample | `2` | - | QI | Boozer transform angular oversampling. |

## Parallelism and performance

| option | set with | default | units | applies to | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PHRPORT_CLEAR_CACHES_EVERY` | environment PHRPORT_CLEAR_CACHES_EVERY | `""` | - | all | Drop JAX caches every N evaluations. |
| `PHRPORT_CLEAR_CACHES_RSS_MB` | environment PHRPORT_CLEAR_CACHES_RSS_MB | `""` | - | all | Drop JAX caches once the process RSS exceeds M MB. |
| `PHRPORT_FB_CHUNK` | environment PHRPORT_FB_CHUNK | `""` | - | finite beta | Virtual-casing source chunk (default 1024; 128 for <= 16 GB devices). |
| `PHRPORT_VMEX_DEVICE` | environment PHRPORT_VMEX_DEVICE | `""` | - | all | cpu pins VMEX to the CPU (XCoil keeps the GPU). |
| `mercier_jac_batch` | profile: equilibrium.mercier_jac_batch | `8` | - | all | DOF columns per batched Mercier pushforward in the exact Jacobian (memory vs speed). |
| `abort_doomed_coil_solves` | --no-abort-doomed-coil-solves | `False` | - | all | Stop a doomed trial's coil solve before its fallback starts (exact). |
| `certify_trials` | --certify-trials | `True` | - | all | Certify trial coil solves (flag --no-certify-trials: only accepted coils; paper). |
| `eq_cache_size` | profile: phr.eq_cache_size | `256` | - | all | Equilibrium results kept in memory (lower it for large QI runs). |
| `fb_jit` | --fb-jit | `vjp` | - | finite beta | Jitted virtual casing: vjp (default), off (eager), check (compare both). |
| `fb_reuse_every` | --fb-reuse-every | `4` | - | finite beta | Refresh the reused plasma field at least every K Jacobians. |
| `fb_reuse_tol` | --fb-reuse-tol | `0` | - | finite beta | Reuse the plasma field while max/dx/ < D since the last refresh (0 = off; tested 2e-3, 1.5x faster). |
| `fd_ngroups` | --fd-ngroups | `8` | - | all | Finite-difference groups (PHR's MPI groups). |
| `overlap_eq_and_coils` | --no-overlap | `True` | - | all | Run the evaluation's VMEX solve in the pool while coils solve (flag --no-overlap). |
| `reuse_vmex_state` | --no-reuse-vmex-state | `False` | - | all | Exact Jacobian reuses the evaluation's converged VMEX state (paper). |
| `skip_coil_on_rejected` | --no-skip-coil-on-rejected | `False` | - | all | Solve VMEX first and skip coil solves of trials TRF will reject (exact). |
| `skip_coil_scope` | --skip-coil-scope | `head` | - | all | Which evaluations are sequenced for skipping: head or all. |
| `n_workers` | --n-workers | `8` | - | all | VMEX worker processes (laptop 2-6; GPU node 1 with exact Jacobian). |
